title: Talk it through 2.3
role: New employee asking about the company's mission and values
can_do: I can talk about a company's mission and values.
I can explain what an organisation stands for and how it acts.

nodes.partner_line: Welcome to the team. Do you know our mission?

options.text: I read it. You aim to make travel fair and sustainable.
Not completely. Could you explain it to me?
Yes, I think it is about local communities.

nodes.partner_line: Right. What do you think our main value is?
nodes.translation: Correcto. ¿Cuál crees que es nuestro principal valor?
nodes.model_reply: I think the main value is respect for local communities.
starters: I think the main value is ...

nodes.partner_line: How does the company show that value in practice?
nodes.translation: ¿Cómo demuestra la empresa ese valor en la práctica?

options.text: By paying fair prices to local suppliers.
By reporting its results openly every year.
By involving residents in every new project.

nodes.partner_line: What are we committed to, as a team?

options.text: We are committed to protecting the places we visit.
We are dedicated to treating every guest fairly.
We have promised to be transparent with our partners.

nodes.partner_line: What would happen if we ignored these values?

options.text: We would lose the trust of our partners.
Our reputation would suffer, and so would our results.
The communities we work with would stop supporting us.

nodes.partner_line: Exactly. I am glad you understand what we stand for.
nodes.translation: Exacto. Me alegra que entiendas lo que representamos.

options.text: Thank you. I am proud to be part of it.
I will do my best to uphold these values.
